name: agent-workflow-benchmark
description: AI-first benchmark workflow for evaluating agent workflows through Codex, Claude Code, and local runner evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate agent workflows with AI-generated cases and runner evidence.
interface.longDescription: Profiles a target agent workflow, uses the runtime LLM to understand it and generate benchmark cases, materializes executable cases, runs Codex/Claude-capable benchmark flows, scores results, and produces explainable reports plus self-debug reverse validation.
defaultPrompt: Benchmark this agent workflow with AI-generated cases.
Diagnose benchmark blind spots with mutations.
